brief_text: ten dominoes stand in a row; the first is tipped over and knocks down the rest, and every domino ends tilted at least 15 degrees from upright

usage.text:

verdict.what_happens: The first domino falls forward and knocks down the remaining nine in sequence. All ten settle by about 1.05 s and remain tilted approximately 71–90 degrees from upright at 6 s.

usage.text:
Yes. The first domino falls forward and touches domino2 at 0.06 s. The chain reaction reaches domino10 at 0.76 s, and all ten settle by about 1.05 s.

At 6 s, every domino is at rest and tilted well beyond 15° from upright: domino1 is approximately 74°, domino2–domino9 are approximately 71–72°, and domino10 lies flat at approximately 90°.

The ten rejected expectations were unsupported checker syntax, not failures of the scene.
